text:
Priya N.: Quick follow-up from the Orion dedicated outage postmortem. Short summary: customer edge flapped routes during backup window and our isolation service misread the transient withdrawals as a sustained split, triggering broad tenant isolation for ~3.5h. Need owners for remediation and a recurrence detector.

Priya N.: Proposed action items:
• Peering harden (per-peer dampening + keepalive tweaks) — owner/ETA
• Isolation service fix (short debounce + verify origin AS + add telemetry) — owner/ETA
• Canary exercise (synthetic /24 + tenant) before prod changes — owner/ETA
• Alerting: route-flap -> auto-ticket + pager for high-impact customers — owner/ETA
• Runbook update & post-change smoke test checklist — owner/ETA

Carlos M.: I can take peering harden. Plan: per-peer dampening for Orion neighbors, increase keepalive to 30s for them only, and add a prefix ACL. ETA: plan + staging tests in 7 days, staged rollout in 12 days.

Yuki H.: Ill own the isolation service fix. Proposed changes: 1) 20s debounce window for withdraw events, 2) require origin-AS match for 60s before isolation decision, 3) emit isolation_decision metrics with context. ETA: hotfix PR in 3 business days, canary in 8 days.

Jules (sre): Ill build the canary harness and smoke checks. Suggest synthetic /24, canary tenant, 30m traffic probe, verify KV cache and latency. ETA: harness in 4 days.

ops-bot: Jira created: RDW-2780 (orion-peering-harden), RDW-2781 (isolation-service-debounce), RDW-2782 (orion-canary-harness). Links: https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2780 , https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2781 , https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-2782

Carlos M.: Preflight check for staging:
```
# BGP neighbor summary on staging-edge
ssh ops@staging-edge 'vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"'
```

Yuki H.: Local churn sim (test-router):
```
# transient withdraws sim
for i in 1 2 3; do ip route add 203.0.113.0/24 via 198.51.100.$i; sleep 15; ip route del 203.0.113.0/24; done
```

Jules (sre): Alert rule suggestion: if >3 BGP resets for a peer in 10m OR >5 route changes for customer prefixes in 15m -> auto-open RDW incident and tag customer. Add Grafana tile: orion_peer_flaps_30d.

Priya N.: Prioritization: RDW-2781 (isolation debounce) = prio:critical, RDW-2780 = prio:high, RDW-2782 = prio:medium. Hotfix should land before any broad isolation-policy changes.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Orion isolation follow-up" at 2265436000. Invitees: @Carlos M., @Yuki H., @Jules (sre), @Priya N.

Carlos M.: Confirmed owner RDW-2780, ETA plan+staging 7 days.
Yuki H.: Confirmed owner RDW-2781, ETA hotfix 3 business days.
Jules (sre): Confirmed RDW-2782, ETA harness 4 days.

Priya N.: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem and add a monthly peering stability check for Orion. If anything changes, update the Jira and ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
